Android catches up to iOS 1.13 in one release, and the version number now follows iOS.

- **Recordings stop disappearing.** A lost microphone, an encoder error or swiping the app away used to delete the half-written recording. It is now kept and finished.
- **Play back recordings** in the app, and **search** across them.
- **Re-transcribe** a recording, and **delete** one, which also clears the audio, queued work and retry state kept on the phone.
- **Onboarding** for first-time users.

Known issue: meetings recorded on 1.13 produce no transcript. Fixed in 1.14.
